info.description:
Auto-generated from the live OpenAPI spec (http://localhost:8082/q/openapi).

141 operations across 118 paths.

**Usage:** run the '🔐 Auth & Setup' folder first — Login (fan) sets {{token}}, Login (admin) sets {{adminToken}}. All /v1/admin/* requests use {{adminToken}}; everything else uses {{token}}. Fill path/id variables (e.g. {{trackId}}) from earlier responses.

Default creds are pre-seeded as collection variables (fanEmail/adminEmail...).
